question: Does a task-derived continuous evidence boundary govern actual WAIT/STOP/RESET payoffs under the same finite-horizon regenerative law?
scope: Declared observed-quality synthetic typed retrieval task, not a hidden semantic memory benchmark or full He-Xiong model. Numerical development plus fresh conditional owner worlds, no architecture/core gain claim.
source_basis: R17 parameter-flow and R15 finite planner were read for state/reset semantics; this new continuous reflected diffusion does not pretend their CTMC is already a continuum law.

task.state: Public quality x in [-4,4] and observed content mode intact/damaged; no future correctness label reaches policy
task.diffusion: Continuous reflected Brownian dx=sigma dW; reflecting endpoints
task.stop_reward: Bernoulli success with current public propensity base_j+amp_j*sigmoid(1.3*x); bases[.2,.1], amplitudes[.75,.4]. This is a synthetic content quality score, not real semantic binding.
task.reset_semantics: Distinct from STOP. Pay fee_j+recoverycarry*rho; wait autonomous rho; sample actual new mode from M_j; return x_reset; continue with t-rho. Disallowed t<rho, allowed t=rho. No reward paid on reset itself.
task.terminal: At fixed deadline STOP and receive actual Bernoulli success; no action may overrun deadline
task.time_regularities: Deterministic minimum recovery can create time kinks at rho and its propagated multiples; no time smoothness asserted there. Spatial smooth-fit checked away from these dates.

solver: Implicit Euler reflecting centered finite-difference QVI min(V-max(g,B), (I-dtL)V-Vprev+c*dt)=0. Reset B uses same task value at t-rho, including subsequent resets and content reward.
independent_reference: Continuous Neumann heat eigenvalues with DCT-I collocation; Bermudan max over STOP, delayed RESET and exact spectral propagation. Uses no FD generator/eigenvalues or primary policy iteration.
fixed_selection: All9 threshold candidates valued under independent same-law reference on the finest mesh. Select highest mean over8 fixed public initial states; persist selection before owner worlds are opened. All candidates measured, no owner outcome selection.

owner.interpretation: Owner Gaussian-fold samples reflected diffusion endpoints; policy acts only on decision mesh. This is not exact continuous first-crossing execution. Use paired seed within profile, conditional on declared states/law; Monte Carlo and discretization uncertainty remain separate.

gradient.method: Differentiate the fixed finite-grid active branch, compare actual centered parameter perturbations. Report all active-set changes; only unchanged branches qualify for ordinary derivative agreement. No hard-action derivative or global moving-boundary derivative claim.
gradient.financial_scope: These4taskcoordinates are not all financial parameters; no whole-financial/all-parameter-gradient closure.
gradient.nonvacuous_gate: At least one registered perturbation case must retain its full active set; zero qualifying cases fails the gate. Every changed case remains in the result and is outside the smooth-branch derivative admission.

outcome_policy: No metric threshold promises a positive control effect in advance. Report both actual success-minus-fee and current-state propensity-minus-fee, paired profile intervals, all arms and any negative results. Ordinary same-law reference is a strong control, not HX-exclusive evidence.
preoutcome_review: After V1 remote freeze59270cd6a7cda3a8a18328c4036603c4f4ea989a but before any registered cases/selection/worlds, independent review found potential empty-generator all() gate. V2 strengthens this gate only; no numerical threshold/physics/selection/case changed.
